_head: Phase 1 measurements, replayable. Boxes are design pt on the iPhone 16 Pro @3x captures in assets/refs, so run with --pt 3. cNN.png is the Nth Mobbin user-profile capture (1179x2556, 393x852pt) with its 120px bottom attribution banner cropped off; the refs are third-party and are not committed, so rebuild them before replaying. --against wants a directory of renders whose names start with each probe's `mine`, made with `refkit shoot <board>.html -o scratch/mine/ --w 478 --h 980 --scale 3 --crop-phone`. Ink probes carry --only ink because batch compares the first colour printed. iOS stem-darkens text: the darkest 2% of a glyph sits about 5 levels below the fill iOS was asked for, so every --only ink probe on type reads darker than the token it justifies. The solid 2pt tab underline (probe `ink`) is the flat authority for --ig-ink and the type probes are the cross-check.
